profile_toml:
name = "bench-market-Automatic-none"
input_format = "csv"

[input]
recursive = true
extensions = ["csv"]

[schema]
id = "bench_market_events"
description = "strata-bench market generator schema"

[[columns]]
name = "timestamp"
logical_type = "timestamp"
nullable = false
unit = "nanoseconds"
hints = ["monotonic", "sorted"]
encoding = ["plain"]

[[columns]]
name = "sequence"
logical_type = "unsigned_integer"
nullable = false
width = "bits64"
hints = ["monotonic", "sorted", "delta_friendly"]
encoding = ["varint"]

[[columns]]
name = "order_id"
logical_type = "unsigned_integer"
nullable = false
width = "bits64"
encoding = ["plain"]

[[columns]]
name = "symbol"
logical_type = "categorical_string"
nullable = false
max_bytes = 8
hints = ["low_cardinality"]
encoding = ["plain"]

[[columns]]
name = "price"
logical_type = "fixed_decimal"
nullable = false
width = "bits64"
precision = 18
scale = 4
hints = ["fixed_precision"]
encoding = ["plain"]

[[columns]]
name = "quantity"
logical_type = "unsigned_integer"
nullable = false
width = "bits32"
encoding = ["varint"]

[[columns]]
name = "side"
logical_type = "enum"
nullable = false
variants = ["buy", "sell"]
hints = ["low_cardinality"]
encoding = ["plain"]

[[columns]]
name = "event_type"
logical_type = "enum"
nullable = false
variants = ["new", "cancel", "fill", "replace"]
hints = ["low_cardinality"]
encoding = ["plain"]

[block]
row_count = 65536

[segment]
target_size_bytes = 268435456

[compression]
codec = "none"
level = 3

[durability]
mode = "fast"
sync_every_blocks = 16

query.text: select sequence where sequence between 50000000 and 50000999

timing_concern: macOS wall time and monotonic elapsed differ by more than 5%; possible system suspension. Sizes and full decode/equality checks remain valid; do not use throughput/latency.
